<h1 class="wp-block-heading has-display-xl-font-size">The Fastest Path <br>to Agents That Work</h1>

<div class="wp-block-comet-code-snippets alignwide comet-code-snippets"><div class="comet-code-snippets__tablist" role="tablist"></div><div class="comet-code-snippets__content">
<div class="wp-block-comet-snippet-group comet-snippet-group"><div class="comet-snippet-group__heading">Opik LLM Evaluation</div><div class="comet-snippet-group__content">
<div class="wp-block-comet-snippet comet-snippet" id="426307a4-d6c5-4c0c-a281-e3bb30d89915"><button id="tab-426307a4-d6c5-4c0c-a281-e3bb30d89915" class="comet-snippet__tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panel-426307a4-d6c5-4c0c-a281-e3bb30d89915"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.comet.com/site/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/any-framework-icon.svg" alt="any-framework-icon.svg" class="comet-snippet__icon"/><span class="snippet-label">Any LLM</span></button><div id="panel-426307a4-d6c5-4c0c-a281-e3bb30d89915" class="comet-snippet__panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-426307a4-d6c5-4c0c-a281-e3bb30d89915" hidden><pre class="comet-snippet__code line-numbers prism-dark language-python"><code>from opik import track

@track
def llm_chain(user_question):
    context = get_context(user_question)
    response = call_llm(user_question, context)
    
    return response

@track
def get_context(user_question):
    # Logic that fetches the context, hard coded here
    return ["The dog chased the cat.", "The cat was called Luky."]

@track
def call_llm(user_question, context):
    # LLM call, can be combined with any Opik integration
    return "The dog chased the cat Luky."

response = llm_chain("What did the dog do ?")
print(response)</code></pre><button type="button" class="comet-snippet__copy-button" aria-label="Copy code to clipboard">Copy</button></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-comet-snippet comet-snippet" id="394b08ed-2cdb-443c-a3d3-33c6c300cdaa"><button id="tab-394b08ed-2cdb-443c-a3d3-33c6c300cdaa" class="comet-snippet__tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panel-394b08ed-2cdb-443c-a3d3-33c6c300cdaa"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.comet.com/site/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-1.png" alt="image-1.png" class="comet-snippet__icon"/><span class="snippet-label">LlamaIndex</span></button><div id="panel-394b08ed-2cdb-443c-a3d3-33c6c300cdaa" class="comet-snippet__panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-394b08ed-2cdb-443c-a3d3-33c6c300cdaa" hidden><pre class="comet-snippet__code line-numbers prism-dark language-python"><code>from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex, global_handler, set_global_handler
from llama_index.core.schema import TextNode

# Configure the Opik integration
set_global_handler("opik")
opik_callback_handler = global_handler


node1 = TextNode(text="The cat sat on the mat.", id_="1")
node2 = TextNode(text="The dog chased the cat.", id_="2")

index = VectorStoreIndex([node1, node2])

# Create a LlamaIndex query engine
query_engine = index.as_query_engine()

# Query the documents
response = query_engine.query("What did the dog do ?")
print(response)</code></pre><button type="button" class="comet-snippet__copy-button" aria-label="Copy code to clipboard">Copy</button></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-comet-snippet comet-snippet" id="2706e820-053d-46a5-abd7-4caf1ddf8ce6"><button id="tab-2706e820-053d-46a5-abd7-4caf1ddf8ce6" class="comet-snippet__tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panel-2706e820-053d-46a5-abd7-4caf1ddf8ce6"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.comet.com/site/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/langchain-1-1.png" alt="langchain-1-1.png" class="comet-snippet__icon"/><span class="snippet-label">LangChain</span></button><div id="panel-2706e820-053d-46a5-abd7-4caf1ddf8ce6" class="comet-snippet__panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-2706e820-053d-46a5-abd7-4caf1ddf8ce6" hidden><pre class="comet-snippet__code line-numbers prism-dark language-python"><code>from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from opik.integrations.langchain import OpikTracer

# Initialize the tracer
opik_tracer = OpikTracer()

# Create the LLM Chain using LangChain
llm = ChatOpenAI(temperature=0)

# Configure the Opik integration
llm = llm.with_config({"callbacks": [opik_tracer]})

llm.invoke("Hello, how are you?")</code></pre><button type="button" class="comet-snippet__copy-button" aria-label="Copy code to clipboard">Copy</button></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-comet-snippet comet-snippet" id="8583ab14-aaec-4561-b5f9-9699caa70074"><button id="tab-8583ab14-aaec-4561-b5f9-9699caa70074" class="comet-snippet__tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panel-8583ab14-aaec-4561-b5f9-9699caa70074"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.comet.com/site/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/OpenAI-code.png" alt="OpenAI-code.png" class="comet-snippet__icon"/><span class="snippet-label">OpenAI</span></button><div id="panel-8583ab14-aaec-4561-b5f9-9699caa70074" class="comet-snippet__panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-8583ab14-aaec-4561-b5f9-9699caa70074" hidden><pre class="comet-snippet__code line-numbers prism-dark language-python"><code>from openai import OpenAI
from opik.integrations.openai import track_openai

openai_client = OpenAI()
openai_client = track_openai(openai_client)

response = openai_client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-3.5-turbo",
    messages=[
        {"role": "user", "content": "Hello, world!"}
    ]
)</code></pre><button type="button" class="comet-snippet__copy-button" aria-label="Copy code to clipboard">Copy</button></div></div>

)

<div class="wp-block-comet-snippet comet-snippet" id="09e6738c-4253-408b-8c58-c35743c6435c"><button id="tab-09e6738c-4253-408b-8c58-c35743c6435c" class="comet-snippet__tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panel-09e6738c-4253-408b-8c58-c35743c6435c"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.comet.com/site/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/any-framework-icon.svg" alt="any-framework-icon.svg" class="comet-snippet__icon"/><span class="snippet-label">Any Framework</span></button><div id="panel-09e6738c-4253-408b-8c58-c35743c6435c" class="comet-snippet__panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-09e6738c-4253-408b-8c58-c35743c6435c" hidden><pre class="comet-snippet__code line-numbers prism-dark language-python"><code># Utilize Comet in any environment
from comet_ml import Experiment

# 1. Define a new experiment
experiment = Experiment(project_name="YOUR PROJECT")

# 2. Model training here

# 3. Log metrics or params over time
experiment.log_metrics(metrics)

#4. Track real-time metrics in Comet</code></pre><button type="button" class="comet-snippet__copy-button" aria-label="Copy code to clipboard">Copy</button></div></div>
</div></div>
